PROTOCOL MODULES

Three interlocking systems that power trustless grant distribution

Create Grants

Define your project scope, set milestones, and establish a reviewer council. Your escrow is created on-chain the moment you submit.

Fund Projects

Contribute XLM directly to grant escrows. Track your funding history and watch milestones unlock in real time.

Verify Milestones

Reviewers examine submitted proof-of-work URLs and vote on approval. Quorum reached = automatic on-chain payout.

HOW IT WORKS

1

Define

Grant owner sets title, budget, milestones, and reviewer council on-chain.

2

Fund

Community contributors deposit XLM into the escrow smart contract.

3

Build

Recipient executes the work and submits a proof-of-work URL per milestone.

4

Review

Reviewers examine proof and vote. Quorum triggers automatic payout.

5

Resolve

Disputes escalate to the global Council for final arbitration.
